turns.t: Doctor, my wife burnt her arm with hot oil, in the kitchen. I put it under the tap straight away, for I don't know how long.
It hurts so much.
Mrs Gupta, I'm Dr Mehra. Let me see. How long ago did this happen?
About an hour. Maybe more. I don't remember, I was so shocked.
It was less than an hour, I'm sure, because I looked at the clock when I phoned the ambulance.
Let's say within the last hour or so, it doesn't matter for treatment. What were you doing? ~
Frying pooris. The oil spat and splashed up my left forearm. ~
How long was it under cold water? ~
I think ten minutes. Maybe fifteen. ~
That's good, that's the right thing to do. Are you diabetic, or do you have any other conditions?
I have diabetes and high blood pressure.
And what do you do for a living?
I'm a school teacher. I use my arms all day, writing.
Let me look at the arm. I'm going to be gentle.
Ow, that's very painful. ~
I know, we'll sort the pain in a moment. There's a red area about ten centimetres by six on the inner forearm, with a few blisters, and it's very tender. The skin around is intact.
Is it bad? ~
It's a partial thickness burn, so the top layers of skin are damaged, but it isn't the deepest kind.
Will it scar? ~
Burns like this usually heal in two to three weeks, often without a scar, if we keep them clean and don't burst the blisters. ~
Oh good. ~
Pulse 92, blood pressure 138 over 84, temperature 36.8, oxygen 99 percent.
She's shaking, doctor. ~
That's the shock and pain. The nurse will give her something for the pain now, and I'll dress the burn with a non-stick dressing. ~
Thank you. ~
I'd like to check your blood sugar now, because with diabetes, infection is a bigger risk.
It was normal this morning. ~
Good. I'd also like to arrange a dressing review in two days, with the nurse, to check for signs of infection.
Okay. ~
Keep the arm raised on a pillow, don't pop the blisters, and keep the dressing dry.
Can I teach tomorrow? ~
With the arm covered, probably, but take it easy. ~
I'll drive her. ~
If the dressing becomes soaked, the redness spreads, you get a fever, or a bad smell, come back immediately.
I will. Thank you. ~
